manifest.selection_rule: per-opponent per-cycle OUTCOME QUOTA: the first 400 losses, the first 400 DRAWS (a tie, or a 250-turn timeout — its OWN bucket, so a stall storm cannot evict the decisive losses), and the first 400 wins of each opponent are persisted as traces; every later battle is played (and counts toward the win rate) but is NOT traced. Under battle-level work-stealing each shard unit carries max(1, ceil(quota / n_shards)), so the per-opponent totals are approximately these. LOSS-ENRICHED BY DESIGN — the traces are a loss-forensics sample, never a random subsample of the cycle.
